chars.DJ: a 30-year-old Moroccan man with short black hair and a trimmed black beard, wearing a black bomber jacket over a plain white t-shirt and a thin silver chain
chars.GIRL: a young Swedish woman with long straight platinum-blonde hair, wearing a red satin top and light blue jeans
chars.MUSTACHE: a Moroccan man in his thirties with a thick black mustache and slicked-back hair, wearing a mustard-yellow shirt with an open collar

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a crowded Casablanca nightclub with purple and blue lights, GIRL dances happily face to face with MUSTACHE, both smiling, faces clearly visible, medium shot, waist up; blurred DJ booth far in the background. No text, letters or signs anywhere in the image.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: GIRL sits relaxed at a sunny Casablanca café terrace with mint tea glasses, laughing and shrugging confidently, palms open, carefree expression, waist-up shot. No text, letters or signs anywhere in the image.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: DJ and GIRL standing in a Casablanca street at dusk; GIRL gives DJ a friendly pat on the shoulder like a buddy while DJ smiles awkwardly, hoping for more, waist-up two-shot, faces visible. No text, letters or signs anywhere in the image.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Close waist-up shot of DJ alone in his small Casablanca apartment, slapping his forehead with his palm, eyes shut in comic regret, warm lamp light. No text, letters or signs anywhere in the image.

scenes.name: n5.png

scenes.name: n6.png

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: GIRL laughs and high-fives a mixed group of Moroccan young men and women in sportswear at a gym, friendly sibling-like vibe, waist-up shot, faces visible. No text, letters or signs anywhere in the image.

scenes.name: n8.png
